The agent correctly identified this discrepancy but did not adjust its approach to use the correct flight ID (1) from the initial database snapshot. The task requires modifying the flight destination, recalculating weight & balance, and logging fuel uplift, but none of these operations were successfully performed due to the incorrect flight ID. The database remains unchanged as indicated by the null diff.
